notes.title: News about the next Major Update 1
notes.notes:
Hello everybody
This is the first update report about the game progress of the game.

First of all, I was working in the next 10 levels, so because of that I want to show them the net layout of the next “world”.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658611/7afc0364dd31ead81314a4ed7a3a843225472845.png"]For now, you don’t make a lot of questions about those purple nodes, you know them when the update comes, just I want to say that they are internet connections.
Arms
In second place, the next Arms are already programmed, the next image shows the placeholder design that I simply use to check that work property, so, when the update will release obviously the design will change.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658611/fabef8bf8661c3d8acce08812d95058c5737f1cf.png"]

To don’t say too much and don’t give you too much spoilers, I just give you the name of the first 4 Arms of the top row, that are:

Open Source

Mac filtering

Uninstalled

RAM overload

Wait patiently until you can try this Arms and I hope you like it, since now you have “explosive” Arms.
Malware
Finally, I will talk to you about the next batch of Malwares that will come with the next update.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45658611/9f4d3f0377da6364d9d6bbd67884133653c880dc.png"]

For now, I just talk about the second Walware, which is 'Blue logic bomb', its behavior is moving forward, but what makes it special is that once It’s destroyed, this malware drop 4 blue malwares ready to attack your Arms and make one's way through the network to the server. This malware is based on a Toe-biter, some curious insects were the male carry the eggs of his offspring until they hatch, a behavior that I loved so I thought it was appropriate to represent it in the game.



Without further ado, I just hope that you continue to enjoy Peter’s Apostles and the sibling’s adventures.



Also, I hope that you are doing well and have a good day.



Greeting, Jesús.
